frame: Farnham & Thomas (2013) PDS Hartley 2 body-fixed planetocentric frame: east-positive longitude, with positive latitude toward the smaller lobe. Figure 3 uses the same E-longitude/latitude map.

entries.name: Variegated waist
entries.description: A smooth waist with repeatable fine-scale markings joins the two lobes.
entries.qualification: Approximate panel centre at 55° N, 30° E. We estimate placement uncertainty at ±3°.

reference.title: Thomas et al. (2013), Figure 7a: waist stereo view

entries.name: Large-lobe smooth patch
entries.description: A darker, smoother area lies among small brighter mounds on the larger southern lobe.
entries.qualification: Approximate panel centre at 53° S, 31° E. We estimate placement uncertainty at ±3°.

reference.title: Thomas et al. (2013), Figure 7b: large-lobe stereo view

entries.name: Elongate smooth area
entries.description: An elongate dark smooth area lies on the larger lobe.
entries.qualification: Representative point read from the map at 50° S, 350° E. We estimate placement uncertainty at ±12°.

reference.title: Thomas et al. (2013), Figure 3a and section 5.2: mapped smooth area
